class.name: HDAResource
class.brief_description: An imported [code].hda[/code] file, as Godot's importer sees it.
class.description: Importing an HDA does not read it: Houdini owns the file, and HEGo hands the path to the session rather than parsing it in Godot. The resource exists so an HDA can be referenced from a scene and shows up in the FileSystem dock.

members.member: Path of the [code].hda[/code] file this resource was imported from.
